_about: The questions that pick which court forms fit. Each option goes to another question (next) or to an outcome. 'petition' outcomes continue into ReadyFile's petition steps; 'forms' outcomes list the forms; 'info' outcomes explain and list no forms to fill.

who.question: Who is the protection order for?
who.hint: This picks the court forms that fit your situation.

options.label: Me
My child, or a child I am the guardian of
An employee of my business or organization
Someone asked the court for an order against me

meWhat.question: What are you trying to do?

options.label: Ask for a new protection order
I already have a protection order
My petition was dismissed and I want it back
I want to withdraw my petition
I want a no contact order in a criminal case

meWhere.question: Where did most of it happen?
meWhere.hint: Pick the closest one. You can describe each time later.

options.label: At or near my home
At or near my work
options.note: Only an employer can file the workplace violence forms (WV-0101). You can still ask for your own protection order, and you can ask your employer to file for you too.

options.label: At or near my school
options.note: The form asks for your school if you and the other person go to the same one. The court may then send a notice to the school (PO-0137).

options.label: By phone, text, or online
Somewhere else, or many places

childWhat.question: What are you trying to do for the child?

options.label: Ask for a new protection order
The child already has a protection order
The child's petition was dismissed and I want it back
I want to withdraw the child's petition

childRole.question: How are you related to the child?
childRole.hint: The petition for a child (PO-0101) asks this in question 1. You file as the child's "next friend."

options.label: I am the child's parent
I am the child's guardian
I am another adult acting for the child

childWhere.question: Where did most of it happen?
childWhere.hint: Pick the closest one. You can describe each time later.

options.label: At or near the child's home
At or near the child's school
options.note: The form asks for the school if the child and the other person go to the same one. The court may then send a notice to the school (PO-0137).

options.label: By phone, text, or online
Somewhere else, or many places

orderWhere.question: Which state or nation issued the order?

options.label: An Indiana court
Another state, a tribe, or another country

orderAction.question: What do you want to do with the order?

options.label: Ask for a hearing on an order issued without one
Change what the order says
Make the order last longer
End the order
Tell the court the other person broke the order

foreignWhat.question: What do you want to do?

options.label: Register the order in Indiana for the first time
Tell the court the order was changed, extended, or ended

employerSize.question: Has your business or organization had at least 2 employees in any work week?
employerSize.hint: Workplace violence orders are for employers (WV-0100). Volunteers and contractors who work at your workplace count as employees.

options.label: Yes
No

employerConduct.question: What did the person do to the employee?

options.label: Hit, hurt, or touched the employee in a rude or angry way
Stalked the employee
Made a believable threat of violence
None of these

employerPlace.question: Did it happen at the workplace, or could it be carried out there?

options.label: Yes
No

employerLabor.question: Is it part of a labor dispute, like a strike or picket line?

options.label: No
Yes

employerWhat.question: What are you trying to do?

options.label: Ask for a new workplace violence restraining order
Renew an order that is ending
options.note: A workplace violence order is renewed by filing a new petition (WV-0101).

options.label: Change an order the court already issued
An order for protection issued without a hearing (ex parte), or a change to one
An Order to Show Cause about workplace violence
An Order to Appear about breaking an order
A Notice to Appear at a hearing

adult-new.title: Petition for an order for protection
adult-new.summary: You will file the petition, the Confidential Form, and the Notice of Exclusion together. The court fills in the cover sheet.

child-new.title: Petition for an order for protection for a child
child-new.summary: You file as the child's next friend. The petition for a child, the Confidential Form, and the Notice of Exclusion are filed together.

reinstate.title: Ask to reinstate a dismissed petition
reinstate.summary: This form is for a petition the court dismissed when it was not your fault, like missing a hearing for a good reason. If you dismissed it yourself, you can file a new petition instead.

withdraw.title: Withdraw a petition
withdraw.summary: The same form also ends an order that was already issued. The form asks for both your address and the other person's address, and it is not confidential.

no-contact.title: No contact orders
no-contact.summary: A no contact order is made by the judge in a criminal case, usually when charges are filed. There is no form to file for one. The prosecutor's office or a victim advocate can tell you about it. You can also ask for your own protection order.

petitioner-hearing.title: Ask for a hearing
petitioner-hearing.summary: Either side can ask for a hearing after an order is issued without one. The address on this form is shared with the other person.

modify.title: Change an order for protection
modify.summary: The court needs a big change in your situation since the order was issued.

extend.title: Extend an order for protection
extend.summary: File this before the order ends. The form asks for the other person's current address so they can be served.

end.title: End an order for protection
end.summary: The form asks for both your address and the other person's address, and it is not confidential.

contempt.title: Tell the court the order was broken
contempt.summary: The petition for contempt is filed with the Order to Appear. The court finishes the Order to Appear. If you did not see or hear what happened yourself, the court needs a sworn statement from someone who did.

foreign-register.title: Register an order from outside Indiana
foreign-register.summary: Use Section A of the form. Bring a certified copy of the order. The court also needs a confidential data form for foreign orders, which the clerk has. The other person is not told about the registration.

foreign-update.title: Update a registered order from outside Indiana
foreign-update.summary: Use Section B of the form. Bring a certified copy of the new order.

wv-not-employer.title: Workplace violence orders are for employers
wv-not-employer.summary: The workplace violence forms can be used only by an employer with at least 2 employees (WV-0100). The employee can ask for their own protection order.

wv-conduct-not-covered.title: This may not fit a workplace violence order
wv-conduct-not-covered.summary: A workplace violence order covers violence, stalking, or a believable threat of violence that happened at the workplace or could be carried out there, and that is not part of a labor dispute (WV-0100). The employee can ask for their own protection order. A lawyer or the court clerk can help with other options.

wv-new.title: Workplace violence restraining order
wv-new.summary: File one petition for each employee. You fill in the Order to Show Cause too, except the hearing dates, the case number, and the judge's signature. The blank Response and Proof of Service forms are served with the papers. Someone other than you serves the papers.

wv-modify.title: Change a workplace violence restraining order
wv-modify.summary: The court needs a big change since the order was issued.

respondent-hearing.title: Ask for a hearing
respondent-hearing.summary: You can ask for a hearing at any time after you are served, and it is free. The address on this form is shared with the other person.

wv-response.title: Respond to a workplace violence petition
wv-response.summary: Fill in the Response and have someone else serve it on the employer. That person fills in the Proof of Service.

respondent-contempt.title: An Order to Appear
respondent-contempt.summary: There is no form to file. The order tells you when and where to go to court. If you do not go, the court can issue a warrant. A lawyer can help.

respondent-notice.title: A Notice to Appear
respondent-notice.summary: There is no form to file. The notice tells you when and where the hearing is. At the hearing, the court can decide things like who lives in a home, property, parenting time, child support, and firearms.
